name: Auto Internal Linking Optimizer
author: Ranjan Kumar

sections.description:
Auto Internal Linking Optimizer helps you add SEO-friendly internal links automatically. Create keyword → URL pairs and the plugin inserts links (first occurrence per keyword) into post content while respecting a global per-post link limit.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload auto-internal-linking-optimizer to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Internal Linking to add keyword → URL pairs and set the max links per post.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Multiple keyword support
  • Per-post max link limit
  • Improved sanitization and nonce checks
  • Translation-ready

1.2.0

  • Initial multiple-keyword release
